what: Observability logging uses a single .aide/recall-log.jsonl file for both recall events AND store events (memory_stored, memory_updated, memory_deleted). Recall logging lives in recall.ts (logRecallEvent), store logging lives in store-log.ts (logStoreEvent). Both are non-fatal. The CLI command recall-log renders both event types.
why: Originally only recalls were logged. User needed store events too for validation — to see what memories got created, not just what was recalled. Keeping them in one file simplifies the CLI and gives a unified timeline.
